scope: Additive Dragon Duke Electro Fangs L1-18 passive chain lightning, target and damage-stage audit.
game_version: Official April 2026 Equipment release; dated secondary claimed client build 18.600.3; frozen 2026-09-17 observation.

sources.title: THE SOUND OF CLASH UPDATE
facts: Electro Fangs are Common Dragon Duke Equipment unlocked at Town Hall 17.
The passive chain hits up to four targets, each jump deals 20% less damage, and damage reaches up to 400 per strike.
sources.limitations: No per-level damage or target count, chain range, candidate order, first-link treatment, integer rounding or tick timing is given.

sources.title: Electro Fangs — Clash of Clans Wiki
sources.version: Client build 18.600.3 as claimed by source
facts: Dated L1-18 table matches frozen HP bonuses 400-2400 and ore costs; Blacksmith level 10 is listed.
sources.limitations: No chain damage or target-count level table or link geometry is published.

sources.title: Electro Fangs
facts: Community L1-18 table reports 330-400 damage per hit and 1-4 chain targets.
Description says the first chain target is separate from the Duke's original target and that ability damage is unaffected by Rage, difficulty modifiers and Royal Rampage.
sources.limitations: The page does not specify chain link distance, target sort, line of sight, damage rounding or fixed-tick ordering; those claims have no matching primary numeric rule.

sources.publisher: Goblins Farm observation captured for TH18 reference
sources.title: Electro Fangs public equipment table, frozen observation
sources.version: 2026-09-17 frozen observation of reported client build 18.400.21
facts: Frozen observation contains all 18 HP bonuses and ore costs plus the primary-source chain summary.
sources.limitations: It explicitly leaves per-level chain damage, link radius, target selection and ordering unresolved.

derivations.result: Preserve the frozen HP/ore table; record the community level damage/count series separately from the official four-target, 20% decay and 400 maximum
derivations.method: Compare the frozen observation, April 2026 release, dated September table and community level table without transferring Electro Dragon targeting or deriving chain rounding.

rejected_inferences.rule: Reuse Electro Dragon or Electro Owl chain target selection
rejected_inferences.reason: Those are different content IDs; Electro Fangs link distance, candidate ordering and hitbox rules are not published.

rejected_inferences.rule: Include Duke's primary target among the 1-4 Electro Fangs targets
rejected_inferences.reason: The community description says the first chain target is separate; primary wording does not settle the numbering or damage stage.

rejected_inferences.rule: Round 20% decay after each chain with ordinary integer truncation
rejected_inferences.reason: The official percentage does not specify multiplication order or rounding, and later hits affect future simulation state.

rejected_inferences.rule: Assume Rage, Royal Rampage and League modifiers affect or never affect chain damage
rejected_inferences.reason: The community page reports immunity, but a primary damage-stage rule and cross-mode verification are missing.

items: primary or game-file verification of per-level damage and chain count
link radius, target classes, candidate sort and entity-ID tie-break
first chain target versus primary target and damage stage
20% decay integer rounding, projectile travel and hit ordering
Rage, Royal Rampage, Pet and League modifier interaction
Viewer lightning, snapshot, replay and RL loadout state

conclusion: Electro Fangs L1-18 remains partial and catalogue-only. The frozen observation and dated 2026 table cover HP/ore levels; Supercell establishes passive chaining to four targets with 20% decay and a 400 strike maximum. Per-level chain values have only community support, and range, target selection, rounding and fixed-tick hit order remain unresolved. No Equipment Core actor is enabled.
